items.source: Return the DestinationResolver to use for resolving destinations names.
items.translation: 返回要用于解析目的地名称的DestinationResolver。

items.source: Note that a DestinationResolver for use with this factory must be able to work without an active JMS Session: for example, JndiDestinationResolver or BeanFactoryDestinationResolver but not SimpleDestinationResolver or DynamicDestinationResolver.
items.translation: 注意，用于此工厂的 DestinationResolver 必须能够在没有活动 JMS Session 的情况下工作：例如，JndiDestinationResolver或BeanFactoryDestinationResolver，但不能是SimpleDestinationResolver或DynamicDestinationResolver。

items.source: Check out DefaultJmsActivationSpecFactory for an extended variant of this class, supporting some further default conventions beyond the plain JMS 1.5 specification.
items.translation: 查看 DefaultJmsActivationSpecFactory，了解此类的扩展变体，该变体支持超出普通 JMS 1.5 规范的一些其他默认约定。

items.source: Applied to each ActivationSpec object before it gets populated with listener-specific settings. Allows for configuring vendor-specific properties beyond the Spring-defined settings in JmsActivationSpecConfig.
items.translation: 在将每个 ActivationSpec 对象填充特定于监听器的设置之前应用。允许配置超出 JmsActivationSpecConfig 中定义的 Spring 设置的供应商特定属性。

items.source: This implementation applies the standard JCA 1.5 acknowledge modes "Auto-acknowledge" and "Dups-ok-acknowledge". It throws an exception in case of CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE or SESSION_TRANSACTED having been requested.
items.translation: 此实现应用了标准的 JCA 1.5 确认模式“自动确认”和“允许重复的确认”。如果请求了 `CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE` 或 `SESSION_TRANSACTED`，则会抛出异常。

items.source:
The 'activationSpecClass' property is required, explicitly defining
the fully-qualified class name of the provider's ActivationSpec class
(for example, "org.apache.activemq.ra.ActiveMQActivationSpec").
items.translation: `activationSpecClass` 属性是必需的，需显式定义提供者 ActivationSpec 类的完全限定类名（例如，"org.apache.activemq.ra.ActiveMQActivationSpec"）。

items.source:
This implementation applies all standard JMS settings, but ignores
"maxConcurrency" and "prefetchSize" - not supported in standard JCA 1.5.
items.translation: 此实现应用了所有标准的 JMS 设置，但忽略了"maxConcurrency"和"prefetchSize"——标准 JCA 1.5 不支持这些设置。

items.translation: 指定目标提供者的完全限定 ActivationSpec 类名（例如，"org.apache.activemq.ra.ActiveMQActivationSpec"）。

items.translation: 确定给定 ResourceAdapter 的 ActivationSpec 类（如果可能）。如果在未显式设置 'activationSpecClass' 的情况下调用。

If not specified, destination names will simply be passed in as Strings.
